meta.title: Travel Policy Update
meta.re: Updated travel & expense policy, effective August 1

blocks.text: Effective **August 1**, three changes apply to travel booking and reimbursement. Everything else in the current policy is unchanged.

items: All flights must be booked through the travel portal; out-of-portal bookings are reimbursed at portal-equivalent fare only.
Hotel cap moves from $220 to $250/night in tier-1 cities.
Receipts are required for any expense over $25 (previously $50).

blocks.title: No action needed
blocks.text: Trips booked before August 1 are grandfathered under the current policy, even if travel occurs later.
Portal compliance fell to 71% last quarter, which costs us negotiated-rate savings and makes duty-of-care tracking unreliable. The receipt threshold aligns us with audit guidance.
Questions: reach Finance Operations on the #travel channel.
